labels.reason: The body contains AUC, T1/2 and C0 summaries for days 1 and 14 during repeated IV dosing. It supports partial experimental-context and evidence-level matches, not individual concentration-time observations or empirically established interindividual variability. The three columns contain parameter names and two sets of reported estimates. Day-column units are MIXED because units vary by parameter row: AUC (µg·min/ml), T1/2 (min), and C0 (mg/ml). The note separately reports AUC in mg·min/ml, creating an unresolved unit conflict. DR008 and MC001 have context evidence but unresolved time-course inputs. No CL or Vss estimate is reported; MC005 and MC006 are not matched. No conversion or bridge is proposed, so DR005 is not matched.

findings.needed_material: Human review of the original Table 4 and associated text to resolve the AUC unit conflict and confirm the text-to-day associations; retain both printed versions until resolved.

findings.reason: A66 supplies repeat-dose regimen and sampling context, but this page contains reported parameter summaries rather than concentration-time records. It states that concentration curves are in Fig. 3 only and are not digitized. Sampling times, concentration observations, individual identifiers, BLQ/LLOQ metadata and missingness definitions are not supplied.
findings.needed_material: Authorized concentration-time inputs and their sampling metadata, or a documented downstream decision restricting this item's use to reported-parameter evidence. Do not reconstruct curves from AUC, T1/2 or C0.
